name: singleM
description: SingleM is a tool for profiling shotgun (both short and long-read) metagenomes.The main idea of SingleM is to profile metagenomes by targeting short 20 amino acid stretches ('windows') within single copy marker genes. It finds reads which cover an entire window, and analyses these further.
approach_detail: Universal Markers, mais aligne les AA traduits, avec DIAMOND BlastX ==> permets de classifier même quand l'ADN a bcp divergé, car la protéine est + conservée
